title: Data Type Identification Quiz
instructions: Below are four variables. Your task is to modify the code so that the `print(type(...))` function correctly outputs the data type for each variable, allowing the solution to pass.
steps: Assign a string (text) value to the `item_name` variable.
Assign an integer (whole number) value to the `stock_count` variable.
Assign a float (decimal number) value to the `item_price` variable.
Assign a boolean (True/False) value to the `is_available` variable.
starterCode:
item_name = # TODO: Add a string value
stock_count = # TODO: Add an integer value
item_price = # TODO: Add a float value
is_available = # TODO: Add a boolean value

# The tests will check the output of these type checks:
print(type(item_name))
print(type(stock_count))
print(type(item_price))
print(type(is_available))
solution:
item_name = "Mug"
stock_count = 150
item_price = 12.99
is_available = True

print(type(item_name))
print(type(stock_count))
print(type(item_price))
print(type(is_available))
hints: Remember to use quotes for strings.
A float value must include a decimal point (e.g., 5.0).
